reviews.text:
A fantastic place to bathe your pet. The machines work well (which is much appreciated) and the place is always very clean. The owner is super friendly. They also have a washing machine for blankets or beds.

Thanks for such a great place! 😊

I took my pets, Tango and Cash, and I loved the loving care they received. Their haircuts and styling were fantastic; they looked like completely different pets! 🙂 I highly recommend going; they also have a self-service pet wash.

Brutus is thrilled. After a trip to the countryside, he came home thinking we'd have to shave him. They treated us wonderfully, and he looked fantastic. Very caring service.
We now have a go-to place for Brutus.

We loved the self-service wash; we could give him a quick bath ourselves without making a mess in the house.

Delighted!
Thank you Isabel and Maxi, I'm glad you're happy with the service!
Excellent service

Why can't I give it fewer stars? I took my dog, who had a beautiful coat, and told them to make her look like a little teddy bear, but they left her with no hair at all and full of uneven patches. I don't recommend it at all; it was a big mistake to take her there.

Great for bathing our furry friends! We really needed a place like this in the neighborhood. I hope it lasts a long time.

They also have a grooming service, and they couldn't treat our dogs better! A fantastic place.
We had an emergency due to an environmental allergy, and they bathed and treated him with appropriate products right away. We are very grateful and will definitely return.

This Monday was our first time at the groomer's. We didn't think our little guy would like it since he's only 6 months old, but from the very first second he bonded with Helene, who took care of us, and wow... the service was a 10/10. He underwent a complete transformation and it was almost as if he wasn't our dog 🤪🤪 and the proof is in the pudding... 👇🏻👇🏻

Helene's hands are truly wonderful; she's restored my dogs Mila and Noa to their Shih Tzu looks, which they hadn't had for a long time! Thank you so much because you do an incredible job. Her professionalism is outstanding, from the moment you arrive until you leave. The attention to detail is crucial, and she helps me follow up on anything that might need veterinary attention during the grooming process. Her knowledge goes far beyond just grooming, which is a guarantee of quality and experience with animals. The service is amazing from the moment you arrive. She assesses the dogs very professionally, asking questions and showing interest in every detail, both in their appearance and their specific needs, creating a fluid conversation where you immediately feel a connection with Helene. I highly recommend that everyone experience this dog grooming salon with Helene. Thank you for your wonderful work with my little ones!
Today I went for the first time with my Labrador and the place is fantastic. Very clean, well-maintained, and perfect for giving your dog a drink. 10 out of 10!
thank you !

⭐️⭐️

Very bad experience. I took Baco to the groomer on Friday, and from that day on, he started having ear problems. On Monday, I had to take him to the vet urgently, and they diagnosed him with otitis and significant irritation.

In addition, they found a lot of hair embedded between the pads of both front paws and a foxtail that had been there for a while, which they had to remove.

If there were any problems handling his paws or doing the job properly during the grooming, I think they should have warned me.

On the other hand, it's a very basic washing service: you can bring the dog in yourself for €12, and the bath they give doesn't include any additional products to make the dog clean and smell good. Honestly, I'd rather bathe him myself at home.

I spoke with the groomer after what happened, but I didn't receive any solution. After this experience, I won't be taking Baco there again.
Excellent service! The result is impeccable. I highly recommend it!
This was the first time we took Coco to this groomer, and honestly, it was great. We were delighted with the service and professionalism. My dog ​​looked gorgeous when he came out.
My dog ​​looks amazing! I've never seen her like this. Thank you!

Helen is an excellent professional! She listens to what you want and takes her time to care for your pet. She exudes a very calming presence. The place is very clean, and what I like most is that you can watch her cut your pet's hair—I really appreciate that transparency! 100% recommended, and I'll definitely be back.
Helene was so sweet with our dog, she made her look gorgeous and Kira was thrilled with her, we highly recommend her ❤️
Helen is an artist! Nothing more to add.

I went for the first time with my cat, a little worried about how the experience would be for him, but Helen treated him with so much love and patience. She helped him shed a lot of fur, and I left delighted.

Thank you so much for everything.
